name: – Julien Sanchez – After § 25 – Am 9/2
title: REPORT on the protection of the European Union’s financial interests – combating fraud – annual report 2024
part_text: 25c. Calls on the Commission to systematically perform cross-checks among infringement proceedings, measures adopted in accordance with Article 6 of the Financial Regulation, and pending conditionality screenings, so that the Member States cannot exploit procedural silos and so that the EU’s financial interests are protected, regardless of the legal instrument used;
